description: Defines the FilterSourceStream class, a specialized SourceStream that reads from an upstream source and applies filtering. Contains method declarations, private state management, and virtual methods for filtering data.

classes.name: FilterSourceStream
classes.description: A class representing a source stream that always has an upstream source and applies filtering to the data read from it.

methods.name: FilterSourceStream
methods.description: Constructor initializing with a source type and upstream SourceStream.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads data into the provided buffer, implementing the SourceStream interface.

methods.name: Description
methods.description: Returns a string description of the stream.

methods.name: MayHaveMoreBytes
methods.description: Indicates if more bytes may be available.

methods.name: ParseEncodingType
methods.description: Parses an encoding type from a string.

methods.name: DoLoop
methods.description: Performs the main processing loop based on the current state.

methods.name: FilterData
methods.description: Pure virtual method to filter data, must be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: GetTypeAsString
methods.description: Returns a string representing the type of the stream.

methods.name: NeedMoreData
methods.description: Indicates if more data is needed from upstream.
